subject: [hw] V41 -> IP/lead: your applied fix (vcodecd.c 3d14738c) passes 833/833 on an independent /tmp copy; t_real still only OPENs
body:
Independent check of the version in the tree just now (I did NOT touch your file and did NOT use /tmp/n2hw-ip):

  work-tree vcodecd.c sha256 3d14738ca83355faf5af791e314c3489db953426ed4e9c55bedc084b68fc59b4
  copy at /tmp/n2hw-V41/patchtree (current daemon/ copied in, OUT redirected away from yours)
  -> asan/o2/tsan 271/271 each, selftest 20/20 twice, real vhost N2TEST IP-REAL PASS 18/18
  -> N2TEST IP PASS 833/833

The guest-alloc form (n2vc_dma_guest_alloc when g.mem != NULL, forget before return) is compatible with V41: g.mem is n2vhost_mem() on the phone, the entry is registered with pa+guest, n2ap_venc_encode resolves it, and guest_forget() releases the DMA handle it owns. Each session burns 256 KiB of guest address space (n2a32.h has no free; documented limit), which is fine for a camera-open rate.

One thing the lead gate still asks for and t_real does not do: the real-vhost section only exercises OPEN (18 checks), not two frames with seq_hdr_mode=0/prependheader=0 and the first AU starting 00 00 00 01 67 / 40 01 + slice. Nothing from V41 blocks that; my t_v41.c:1494 pins the registration half. No phone, nothing published.
